Leena (partnerships): Heads-up — AWS Marketplace PO PO-738412 just got REJECTED by the portal. Partner reports ship-to address + entity mismatch and a redline on incoterms. @Priya can you take a look?
Rafael (procurement): Saw the rejection. Marketplace returned: "entity_mismatch: ship_to_ein != billing_ein" :grimacing:
onboarding-bot: PO PO-738412 status: REJECTED — reason=entity_mismatch; code=422; link=https://mp.marketplace/po/PO-738412
Nate (sales): Customer is on a tight launch window — asked if we can manual-override so they can start onboarding in 48h.
Rafael (procurement): Manual override needs legal + PartnerOps approval. Also taxing consequences if incoterms change DDP -> DAP.
Priya (legal): Quick Q: do we have reseller certificate or proof of US entity for shipments? If not, we can't just change EIN mapping.
Leena (partnerships): Partner uploaded a reseller cert but their portal shows two ledgers: "Acme Cloud Ltd (UK)" and "Acme Cloud US" — different EINs. They insist shipments originate from US.
Rafael (procurement): Short-term workaround: re-issue PO with US billing entity and same SKUs. Downside: marketplace mapping update still required on partner side (48-72h).
Nate (sales): If we re-issue PO, can we preserve co-sell incentives? Partner said they need marketplace billing to trigger co-sell.
Priya (legal): Options: 1) Accept partner redline (incoterms) and sign amendment — likely adds ~30d to legal cycle. 2) Re-issue PO with correct entity and request expedited mapping from partner. Recommend 2 for speed.
Leena (partnerships): Ok — Rafael please open partner ticket and request expedited entity mapping. Priya please ack feasibility by EOD. Nate to message the customer with the timeline. :eyes:
Rafael (procurement): Opening ticket now. Creating minimal summary for PartnerOps: 
```
{
  "po": "PO-738412",
  "ship_to": "Acme Cloud US",
  "billing_ein": "12-3456789",
  "ship_to_ein": "98-7654321",
  "incoterms": "redlined DDP -> DAP"
}
```
onboarding-bot: Ticket TKT-9921 created and linked to PO-738412; partner notified.
Leena (partnerships): Thanks — please cc legal on the ticket and paste any confirmation email from partner once they update mapping. Also add a temporary route to avoid automatic marketplace fallback for this account.
Rafael (procurement): Will do. I pinged PartnerOps in the ticket and asked for 24h expedite. Updating ticket with the reseller cert.
Priya (legal): Acknowledged. I'll review the incoterms impact and reply on the ticket by EOD. If legal ok, we can approve re-issue.
Nate (sales): I'll tell the customer: re-issuing now, estimate mapping 24-72h; we'll push for 24h. Will ask if they can accept interim manual billing.
Leena (partnerships): Perfect. Follow-ups: Rafael updates TKT-9921; Priya posts legal note; Nate informs customer. I'll track in the marketplace escalation doc. :+1:
Rafael (procurement): Updating now.
